note: AUTO5 (round 24 live 42e43e14, branch auto/spirit-companions): the Spirit Companions sphere's combat surface. Binding Seal, its Punishing/Ward/Host consequences, and the two printed Cultivation Checks that were never rolled. Companion plug-in: APP/combat/ext/spirit_seals.py. Non-combat text (downtime, crafting, social, story) stays a rider by design.

TAL_SPIRIT_COMPANIONS_BINDING_SEAL.reviewed_by: auto5 2026-10-04: the sphere's core seal becomes a real Action. It was typed 'passive', so no character ever got the button and the printed Wisdom saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC never happened. A failure leaves the spirit Restrained under a Binding Seal mark; combat/ext/spirit_seals.py carries the printed clauses that hold while the seal does (it cannot move beyond the bond, it cannot attack its binder, a coercive command costs 1 Bond Strain). The Bind the Violent Ghost disadvantage reads the binder's own named mark (disadvantage_if_marked), so only a binder who owns that talent and marked this spirit gets it.

tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.bind_th.reviewed_by: auto5 2026-10-04: the typed modifier now reaches the real Binding Seal button (it modifies a passive record before, so nothing answered it). Its choice between 'Advantage on the Binding check' and 'Disadvantage on its saving throw' is the two printed words of one sentence and runs as the table's Binding Seal saving throw: combat/ext/spirit_seals.py marks every spirit that actually attacked this binder or one of their allies this scene (an attack is an attack whether it hit, and before any seal exists), and TAL_SPIRIT_COMPANIONS_BINDING_SEAL's save row reads that mark by name (disadvantage_if_marked), so the disadvantage belongs to the binder who owns this talent and to no one else.

tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.name_bi.reviewed_by: auto5 2026-10-04: Binding Seal became a real Action, so Name-Binding's modifier now reaches its save. Its 'Every time the standing command forces unwilling service, increase Bond Strain by 1' is the same printed disobedience the seal family already asks about after Command Bonded Spirit, so combat/ext/spirit_seals.py charges it there (block spirit_seal kind 'name'). 'Disadvantage on its first attempt to break the seal' needs an event the engine cannot report -- nothing says a spirit tried to break its seal -- so that one sentence stays this talent's rider and its modifier carries no effect until the event exists.

tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.break_t.reviewed_by: auto5 2026-10-04: the printed Cultivation Check against the binder's Cultivation Save DC was a rider, so the ability rolled no die. It is now one contest per printed choice, measured against the DC combat/ext/spirit_seals.py's seal_binder provider reads off the target's own seal (combat/typed_executor.resolve_opposed_check's documented 'dc' check: a printed DC is met by matching it). Each outcome is nested under that check's on_success, so a FAILED check does nothing; each option repeats the shared Cultivation Check because a 'choose one' ability compiles one action per option and the shared part is not run on its own; the suppress option ends at the end of the Binder's NEXT turn, as printed (an 'until_end_of_turn' row on your own bonded spirit would have ended this turn).

tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.exorcis.reviewed_by: auto5 2026-10-04: the printed Cultivation Check against the spirit's Cultivation Save DC or the binder's was a rider, so the ability rolled no die. It is now one contest per printed outcome, measured against the DC the target's own seal answers for (combat/ext/spirit_seals.py's seal_binder provider reads the binder's Cultivation Save DC from the seal condition; a creature wearing no seal falls back to its own DC). Each outcome is nested under that check's on_success, so a FAILED check changes nothing, and each option repeats the shared Cultivation Check because a 'choose one' ability compiles one action per option and the shared part is not run on its own. 'force the spirit to manifest adjacent to the host' is a rider: the table has no hosting relationship to read, so it must not move the exorcist's own companion. The label is the only change; the check and its outcome are untouched.
